prompts.prompt: Wide shot of a dimly lit Stockholm dinner-show hall, long candlelit tables set with white linen, a performer mid-song on a small stage bathed in warm amber spotlights, disco lights glowing further back where a nightclub dance floor is visible.

Medium shot of guests in evening wear clinking wine glasses at a long banquet table, plates of a three-course dinner half-finished, a singer in a sequined jacket performing on stage just behind them under theatrical pink and gold lighting.

Stylized Greek taverna interior on a Stockholm stage, blue-washed walls and hanging vines, ABBA-style dancers leaping between candlelit tables as guests raise ouzo glasses, the front row cheering with raised hands in warm amber light.

Close-up of a bartender's hands shaking a cocktail beside a low-lit bar counter, bottles backlit in copper, a DJ silhouetted behind a turntable setup glowing blue further into the room, condensation on the glass catching the warm light.
